description: This file defines the BlockQuoteHandler class, which manages the behavior and rendering of block quote spans within a markdown editing context using the Markwon library.

classes.name: BlockQuoteHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages block quote spans in markdown editing, including initializing theme, persisting spans, and applying spans to editable text.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the theme based on the Markwon instance's configuration.

methods.name: configurePersistedSpans
methods.description: Configures the builder to persist BlockQuoteSpan instances with associated theme.

methods.name: handleMarkdownSpan
methods.description: Applies the BlockQuoteSpan to the specified range within the Editable text.

methods.name: markdownSpanType
methods.description: Returns the class type of the BlockQuoteSpan being handled.
